American companies acquired about 40% of ADNOC's pipeline assets for nearly $4 billion, while Eni acquired 20% of Abu Dhabi Oil Refining Company for over $3 billion. Austrian company OMV also invested about $2.8 billion for approximately 15% in ADNOC's refining business in partnership with Eni.
